UI-01 · Budget · High impact · Medium effort

Keep the total and the focused field visible

The sticky Baku total is 191.67 px high at 320 px. It masks 25 of 44 px of a focused input. The 46.86 px rental heading can be wholly masked at 320 and 390.

Proposed change
Put the per-adult and three-person amounts side by side in a compact sticky total. Keep SAR with its value up through SAR 4,200,000 and show the spending-status line. Move the contingency explanation beside the fields. Reveal a focused budget control below the visible sticky navigation and total, with 8 px clearance. Keep the same inputs, rules, print and reset.

Measured mockup overlay
Source and prior decisions

source/app.js: paintTotal, budgetField and delegated focus. source/styles.css: .budget-total and budget controls. Tests at 320 and 390 check 0 px of focus obstruction and a single line per amount.

The earlier mobile revision pinned the total during entry. Keep the pin and reduce its footprint.

Copy changes
  • C22 group → For three
  • C23 each → Per adult
  • C24 Group total → Total for three
Decision for UI-01

UI-02 · Navigation and city index · High impact · Medium effort

Show where you are and make every nav label easy to tap

Cities and Winter are 31.7 and 36.1 px wide at 320. At 320, 390 and 667, the closed chapter menu shows the current section in 0 of 105 direct-link states. Changing the selected city shifts row content 7.19 px.

Proposed change
Use at least 44 by 44 px for direct navigation. Keep all three mast links at 320 with smaller gaps. Put the current section in the compact menu summary and include the visible name and city in its accessible name. Match the section headings for Stays, Itinerary and Photos. Keep the city name, price and arrow rails steady during selection and hover at edited as well as default prices.

Measured mockup overlay
Source and prior decisions

source/styles.css: shared target size, compact mast, fixed city-list rails. source/app.js: one active section updater shared by the full and compact navigation, called on direct jumps and observer changes.

Keep direct Winter and all five cities visible, along with the approved destination sequence.

UI-03 · Selected Walk · High impact · Medium effort

Keep the chosen route in sight

At 320, 8 of 55 chooser labels exceed 250.4 px with minutes appended. At 667 by 375, 0 of 55 selected traces are visible immediately after changing the chooser.

Proposed change
Use place names in the phone chooser and show time and distance in the selected summary. Shorten only the two still-clipping picker labels while retaining full names on the map and in the route list. Put the repeated route list behind All walk times on phones and preserve its open state and the selected button's focus. At short landscape, place the map beside the chooser and summary. Keep at least 90 percent of the map and the full trace and pins visible after a route change, with the chooser still reachable.

Measured mockup overlay
Source and prior decisions

source/app.js: paintMap, route select and route-button change handlers. source/styles.css and source/winter.css: short-landscape map composition and mobile disclosure. Test all 55 routes, marks, backgrounds and navigation destinations.

Owner said “I want the path to be shown better with real satellite or terrain.” Keep both basemaps, source credit, scale and exact route and provider coordinates.

UI-04 · Photo viewer · Medium impact · Small effort

Give the photo viewer a useful height

Baku's photo has a 296 by 486 px box at 320 with only 196 px of actual image height. At 390 the unused vertical area reaches 323 px. Prague has up to 407 px.

Proposed change
Use the photo's intrinsic aspect ratio and cap its height as the viewport shortens. Keep the caption and the existing Close, Previous, Next and Download actions together. Retain keyboard cycling, focus return and all author credits.

UI-05 · Cities map and globe · High impact · Medium effort

Make the optional globe easy to find and fit

At 320, the globe controls begin at y731 in a 725 px viewport. At 667, 178.8 of 396.7 px of the globe are clipped after activation. The loading label shifts the toggle by 19.84 px.

Proposed change
Add a Map & globe jump beside the Cities heading on compact layouts without adding a row at 320. Focus the panel on arrival. In short landscape, place controls beside a shallow map so the full globe and chapter action fit below the mast. Reserve the loading-label width and announce loading and fallback in plain text.

source/index.template and source/atlas.js for panel jump and feedback. source/styles.css for the compact heading, stable toggle and short-landscape grid. Re-test real WebGL, reduced motion, fallback and map labels.

Earlier approval keeps all five cities visible before the optional map at 320 and 390. The shortcut does not reorder cities. Existing geographically correct paths stay intact.

UI-06 · Winter previews · High impact · Medium effort

Open a complete Stageshow scene in landscape

At 667 by 375 the Stage opens with 271 of 365 px visible and 0 of 44 px of the focused trigger. At 390, the stage fits but changing scenes requires waiting for the sequence.

Proposed change
Keep actual Stageshow playback. Use a shallow short-landscape composition with legible body text. Place Close before the frame and focus it while the full stage is in view. UI-07 · Stays · High impact · Medium effort

Show price, beds and outdoor space before booking notes

At 390 px, the first budget action starts at y990–1250 across the five direct stay links. A 304 px outdoor shortlist precedes Baku's priced stays. Tbilisi's two prices differ by 55.28 px vertically at 768.

Proposed change
Show the main options first. Put dated price, occupancy, beds, outdoor status and material caveats before the two actions. Use Listing notes for supplementary booking details. Move the optional outdoor shortlist after the priced stays. Use one price rail for the two options on wider layouts where subgrid fits. Keep the listing name, price caveat and room-gallery link.

UI-08 · Compare and sources · Medium impact · Medium effort

Scan the comparison and reach its evidence

At 320, comparison labels wrap to 3–5 lines. The target band contrast against its track is 1.37:1. At 390, 17 of 18 Baku source links and 42 of 48 photograph credit links miss 44 px in at least one dimension. Wide methodology runs reach 201 characters.

Proposed change
Shorten repeated comparison labels and use concise outdoor statuses that preserve access and uncertainty. Keep listing-specific notes in Stays. Mark the budget range with a contrast edge and keep its text key legible at very high amounts. Keep the chart and semantic table and remove the chart's surrounding card fill. In opened source lists, render separate 44 px source and license actions. Split methodology into walking, atlas and currency topics under the existing reading measure.

Measured mockup overlay
Source and prior decisions

source/app.js: comparePrices and paintEvidence. source/winter.js and source/winter.css: target band and chart layout. source/styles.css: source targets and reading measure. Test no table overflow or lost captions, links, or assumptions.

Keep all cited evidence and outdoor-space distinctions. All exact amounts remain available.

Decision for UI-08
